summary: Iteration 23 (Import History + Undo + Permission-gated UI + Show Manifest PDF) — Backend 5/5 pytest green; frontend flows all pass. Backend: GET /api/imports returns newest-first batch rows with all required fields ({id, entity, user_email, created_count, created_ids, duplicates, invalid, undone, created_at}); POST /api/costumes/import with dry_run=true does NOT record a batch, dry_run=false records entity='costumes' batch; POST /api/equipment/import records entity='equipment' batch; POST /api/imports/{id}/undo deletes created_ids from correct collection, sets undone=true + undone_count, returns {undone:true, deleted:n}; second undo → 409; unknown id → 404. Frontend: admin sees import-costumes-btn + import-history-btn on /inventory, import-equipment-btn + import-equipment-history-btn on /equipment (header shows 'IMPORT HISTORY · EQUIPMENT', filter working — only equipment rows shown); wardrobe-print-btn visible on /wardrobe; on E2E Test Show detail page show-print-manifest-btn present, show-manifest-sheet DOM present with exactly 2 manifest-row-* rows matching the 2 attached costumes; UI import → undo flow removes the created costumes from inventory list on close (verified TEST_ITER23_UI_C1 gone).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (>4300 lines) — imports + import-history endpoints (~L2771-3102) are self-contained and would be a clean split into routers/imports.py.
GET /api/imports has no auth/org scoping — every logged-in user sees all batches across all orgs. Consider filtering by request user's org_id and/or restricting to users with imports.view (or admin).

POST /api/imports/{id}/undo also lacks permission gating and org scoping — a member of one org could undo another org's batch if they knew the id. Add role-based check consistent with other write endpoints.

Undo detaches items from maps via _detach_item_from_all_maps but this happens BEFORE the delete_many; if delete_many partially fails the maps are already mutated. Consider wrapping in a session/transaction or delete first, then detach.
ImportHistoryDialog polls only on open; if two admins are working in parallel the second admin's history view can go stale. A lightweight WS/SSE push (or 10s polling) would improve UX.
